chapters.title: Pallorbasalt Trial 1
chapters.blurb: Mass bends the world here; heavy places pull wanderers toward them whether they wish it or not. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 6, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Pallorbasalt Trial 1: fault 0 [0..26], relay 3 [0..6], code 0 [0..10]
  [0] siphon: my fault += ((their action == 2) ? 3 : 0); my fault += 1
  [1] surge: their relay += 3; my relay += 2; my fault += ((their action == 4) ? 4 : 0)
  [2] anchor: my fault += 4; my relay += 3
  [3] pulse: my fault += ((their action == 0) ? 4 : 0); my fault += 1
  [4] ward: my fault += ((their action == 2) ? 6 : 0); my fault += 1; their fault += -1; my fault += 1
  [5] erode: their code += 1
  ends: (my fault >= 20) => I win; after 15 rounds higher 'fault' wins

chapters.title: Pallorbasalt Trial 2
chapters.blurb: Mass bends the world here; heavy places pull wanderers toward them whether they wish it or not. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 7, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Pallorbasalt Trial 2: pallor 0 [0..26], relay 0 [0..5], fault 3 [0..6]
  [0] sever: my pallor += 1; their fault += 3
  [1] tether: their pallor += -1; my pallor += 1
  [2] kindle: my pallor += ((their action == 1) ? 2 : 0); my pallor += 1
  [3] weave: their fault += 3; my fault += 2; my pallor += ((their action == 2) ? 4 : 0)
  [4] ward: my relay += 2; my pallor += ((their action == 3) ? 4 : 0)
  each round: my pallor += 1
  ends: (my pallor >= 20) => I win; after 19 rounds higher 'pallor' wins

chapters.title: Pallorbasalt Trial 3
chapters.blurb: Mass bends the world here; heavy places pull wanderers toward them whether they wish it or not. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 5, proposer grammar).
chapters.text:
Pallorbasalt Trial 3: bloom 5 [0..28], drift 0 [0..10], reef 0 [0..6]
  [0] ward: their bloom += ((their action == 2) ? -2 : 0); my bloom += ((their action == 2) ? 1 : 0)
  [1] kindle: my bloom += 1
  [2] glide: my bloom += 2
  [3] pulse: my bloom += ((their action == 1) ? 4 : 0); my bloom += 1
  each round: my reef += -1
  ends: (my drift >= 10) => I lose; (my bloom >= 22) => I win; after 29 rounds higher 'bloom' wins

tagline: Three trials of the Pallorbasalt. Learn each law, then outplay the adaptive rival.
